scripts.rust:clippy: node scripts/cargo.mjs clippy --locked --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && node scripts/cargo.mjs clippy --locked --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p vd-render -p vd-web -- -D warnings && node scripts/cargo.mjs clippy --locked --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p vd-web --features labs -- -D warnings
scripts.check:rust-lint: npm run rust:fmt && npm run rust:clippy
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run check:rust-lint && npm run test:rust
scripts.build: npm run wasm -- --all && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json --tsgo && vite build
scripts.build:pages: npm run wasm -- --all && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json --tsgo && vite build --base=/vector-defence-3d/
